trap.label: hífen sem plural
trap.wrong: We took a three-hours walk across the salt marsh.
trap.right: We took a three-hour walk across the salt marsh.
trap.why: Em português “caminhada de três horas” mantém o plural. Em inglês, em adjetivos compostos o substantivo fica no singular.

mcq.q: “5:42 a.m. A harrier quarters the reeds” gives...

fix.wrong: A harrier quarter the reeds at dawn.
fix.right: A harrier quarters the reeds at dawn.

fix.wrong: We saw a ten-meters tall reed.
fix.right: We saw a ten-meter tall reed.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva como adjetivo composto: “a walk of three hours”
Reescreva com hífen: “a marsh wrapped in mist”
Reescreva no presente histórico: “At 5:42 a.m. a harrier quartered the reeds.”
rewrite.answer: At 5:42 a.m. a harrier quarters the reeds.
